original_test_intent: Confirm the approved DCGM diagnostic behaves correctly under the intended shell, systemd and container environment without secret leakage, unintended library selection or GPU-visibility changes.
original_method: Define required, forbidden and redacted variables plus source/precedence for operator, dcgmi, service and container; record compatible builds and baseline device visibility; preserve logs; start the service in its approved environment, set persistence if authorized, run the complete level-4 suite, compare environment-dependent results and verify no drift or secret disclosure.
manual_activity: Platform owner approves required/forbidden variables, precedence and redaction across shell, systemd and container contexts; operator validates isolation and authorizes runtime state changes.
required_inputs: Redacted environment allowlist and forbidden-variable list
Variable source/precedence for operator, service and container
Compatible driver/DCGM versions and service order
Isolation, OOB, monitoring and stop limits
safety_requirements: Never record secrets or embed passwords in commands
Preserve full level-4 output and system logs
Apply only approved bounded environment changes
Restore environment/runtime state and do not auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect only allowlisted redacted environment evidence
Validate precedence, library/device visibility and package compatibility
Run one approved complete level-4 diagnostic
Restore context and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve variables, precedence, redaction and expected subtests
Resolve service order, level and final state

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It does not test the named environment contract, exposes password handling, disables host verification, truncates output and contradicts the source level.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Launch the service and dcgmi with separately captured approved redacted environments, then retain the entire source level-4 result without exporting secrets.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Level 4, persistence enablement, 120-minute allowance and error-free subtests remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare effective redacted environments and precedence at the operator, service and container boundaries while correlating library/device visibility with complete diagnostic results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an explicit environment oracle, secrecy controls, context separation and post-run drift check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic diagnostic invocation cannot validate Environment Variables when none are identified or measured.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Environment changes can select wrong CUDA libraries, hide devices, alter proxy behavior or leak credentials into logs.

project_override_considerations: The project must publish the minimal environment contract for the deployed host/service/container image and define variables whose presence is itself a failure.
expected_evidence: Redacted variable/value-or-presence matrices by process context
Library paths and GPU visibility under each approved context
Service/persistence transitions and complete level-4 output
No-secret/no-drift postcheck, final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Service start follows diagnostic execution, DeepSeek requests level-1 evidence for a level-4 command, and the source provides no environment-variable set or expected values for the named Items coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks only if environment contract/redaction, compatible stack, supported order, isolation or recovery cannot be defined.
